The '''Canvas Room''' is located right below the [[Flower House]] and is accessed by a teleport pad in it, next to [[Marco]]. In the '''Canvas Room''' the player can draw freely on a wool canvas using a [[Spray Can]]. This will not consume any dye from the Spray Can.

== Purpose ==
The '''Canvas Room''' is a large space underground, with a teleport pad leading back to the {{Zone|Flower House}}. There is a platform extends to the center, and stairs leading down on either side. There are flowers decorating the sides of the '''Canvas Room''', and directly in front of the platform is a large wool canvas. The size of the wool canvas in the room is 32 * 32.
